acceptance.scheduling: Core tests reproduce the 10:37 now / 11:25 availability example: an old relative-bin/top-of-hour combination would fire at 11:00; the new plan fires at 12:00. Exact-hour availability stays at that hour. DST/timezone cases, cumulative counts, maximum cohorts, vacation/no delivery, foreign request ownership and capacity reservation are covered. No earlier than the supplied stored availability dates is claimed; OS delivery time and existing second-resolution storage are separate limits.
acceptance.ownership: A serialized worker fences stale reads and noncooperative additions, reserves room for unrelated pending requests, clears managed work on disconnect/vacation and exposes source/add/badge failures for retry. Permission checks reserve ownership before awaiting status. Notices are returned to the originating view, not a global presentation flag; per-option UUID intents reject stale System Settings returns and preserve independent windows.
acceptance.parity: Three existing preference keys/defaults remain archive-compatible on iOS; native defaults store Bool values under their own namespace. Banner/badge/sound choices are independent, including sound with badges when banners are off. Disabling sound preserves the current enabled badge. Background/foreground refreshes do not prompt. The previous legacy post-sign-in request remains; native sign-in and settings supply an explicit permission action.
acceptance.watch: Updates no longer depend on notification choices. Logout and vacation zero review data; level progress and existing packet keys remain. Latest data waits for actual activation, deactivated phone sessions reactivate and a first packet is deduplicated for thirty seconds. Nil-session hosted tests cover first/change/clock/logout behavior without activating WatchConnectivity.
acceptance.tests: 377 shared functions per platform: Core 191, persistence 145, speech 7, app model 15 and notification owner 19. Five old app-only permission functions moved to portable coverage; four archive/watch integration functions replace them, giving 93 hosted functions. Parameter executions are not additional functions.
acceptance.ui_scope: Final typed intent/sound source is compiled and exercised by shared suites on both platforms, final native settings/sign-in (2), final tablet Mainboard settings gate (4), final phone notification persistence (1), hosted tests and both Release builds. Earlier expanded Mac and phone/tablet Home/reconnect runs cover unchanged lesson, Home, vacation and reauthentication behavior; they are checkpoint evidence, not an all-case final-source bundle. Four distinct Mac cases and six distinct UI cases per phone/tablet occur across recorded runs; overlaps are not counted twice.
acceptance.isolation: Every notification operation is injected for synthetic UI/unit accounts. These tests do not request real OS authorization, change real badges, register real alerts, access browser credentials, take real WaniKani exercises or change real accounts. Sample-mode release roots receive no notification service. Only explicit test-app windows are captured on Mac.
